title: Comfort Movies
intro: Some nights you just need a film that holds you gently and sends you to bed smiling. Pull the blanket tighter and let these ones in.

films.title: Paddington 2
films.line: A film so full of warmth it feels like being handed a cup of tea by the universe.

films.title: Chef
films.line: Food, music and second chances fold together into something genuinely nourishing for the soul.

films.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
films.line: A pastel-coloured fever dream that somehow leaves you feeling completely held and delighted.

films.title: About Time
films.line: A quiet gut-punch dressed as a rom-com, reminding you to live inside ordinary moments.

films.title: Julie & Julia
films.line: Two women across decades find themselves through butter, ambition and the courage to begin.

films.title: Singin' in the Rain
films.line: Pure joy rendered in colour and choreography, the kind that makes cynicism feel embarrassing.

films.title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
films.line: A quiet dreamer steps into the wild and finds a life worth living.

films.title: Amélie
films.line: Paris glows a little warmer when one tender soul decides to change the world.
